items.headline: Extended Sets November $XTEN Launch, 30% to Points Users
items.summary: Perp DEX Extended will launch $XTEN in November, allocating 30% of supply to points users via self-hosted Arc wallets. Full tokenomics drop with a MiCA white paper on Oct. 31.

items.headline: $INIT Halts L1 and Rollups After Mint Exploit
items.summary: Initia froze its L1 and rollups after a reported mint exploit, with an estimated $2.6M cashed out and a later 1,135.5 ETH transfer spotted onchain. $INIT holders are watching for the postmortem.

items.headline: $SWELL Pauses swETH and rswETH After NAV Issue
items.summary: Swell has paused $swETH and $rswETH deposits and withdrawals, saying NAV must be corrected before reopening. Onchain controls now block withdrawal requests and ETH claims.

items.headline: Uniswap Taps 7 Rival Liquidity Sources to Burn $UNI
items.summary: Uniswap will route flow from seven rival liquidity sources to fund $UNI token burns, a fresh value-accrual twist for the DEX giant's token.

items.headline: $STRK Community Backs Post-Quantum Layer 1 Pivot
items.summary: Starknet's community overwhelmingly backed research into becoming an independent post-quantum Layer 1, with a draft whitepaper expected in November. Big pivot ahead for $STRK.
